scripts/faq-fetch.ts.name: Fetch FAQ snapshots
scripts/faq-fetch.ts.description: Queries the Notion FAQ CMS for publishable rows and writes one JSON snapshot per docs page; the only step that talks to Notion.

scripts/fetch-edge-challenge-data.ts.name: Fetch BoLD challenge snapshot
scripts/fetch-edge-challenge-data.ts.description: Pulls BoLD ChallengeManager edge logs from Arbitrum Sepolia into the static JSON the edge-challenge widget renders; no check mode.

scripts/gas-target-fetch.ts.name: Fetch gas targets
scripts/gas-target-fetch.ts.description: Reads each public Arbitrum chain's gas target from the ArbGasInfo precompile over RPC and writes the gas-target snapshot.

scripts/generate-cli-reference.ts.name: Generate CLI flags page
scripts/generate-cli-reference.ts.description: Reads flag registrations from Nitro's Go source at the pinned tag and rewrites the CLI flags reference page; --check diffs instead.

scripts/generate-contract-addresses.ts.name: Generate contract addresses
scripts/generate-contract-addresses.ts.description: Renders the contract-address partial from @arbitrum/sdk networks plus the hand-pinned addresses; --check is the CI gate.

scripts/generate-faq.ts.name: Generate FAQ partials
scripts/generate-faq.ts.description: Writes the six troubleshooting partials from the committed Notion FAQ snapshots; --check is the CI gate and needs no network.

scripts/generate-gas-target.ts.name: Generate gas-target partial
scripts/generate-gas-target.ts.description: Renders the gas-target reference partial from the committed ArbGasInfo snapshot; --check is the CI gate.

scripts/generate-legacy-redirects.mjs.name: Port legacy redirects
scripts/generate-legacy-redirects.mjs.description: Converts the Docusaurus-era vercel.json redirect map into root-level sources aimed at /docs pages, parking unresolvable ones in a todo file.

scripts/generate-precompile-tables.ts.name: Generate precompile tables
scripts/generate-precompile-tables.ts.description: Rewrites the precompile-table partials from the Solidity interfaces and Go implementations at the pinned Nitro refs; --check compares.

scripts/generate-stylus-examples.ts.name: Generate Stylus examples
scripts/generate-stylus-examples.ts.description: Clones offchainlabs/stylus-by-example at the pinned commit and rebuilds the Stylus by Example pages, refusing MDX it did not write.

scripts/lib/cli-reference-page.ts.name: CLI page renderer
scripts/lib/cli-reference-page.ts.description: Renders the generated region of the Nitro CLI flags page as GFM tables grouped by namespace and splices it between the markers on disk.

scripts/lib/contract-addresses.ts.name: Contract address renderer
scripts/lib/contract-addresses.ts.description: Renders the contract-address partial body: one markdown table per contract group, one column per chain, an AEL cell per address.

scripts/lib/current-redirects.mjs.name: Current redirect mapping
scripts/lib/current-redirects.mjs.description: Maps the URLs docs.arbitrum.io serves today onto this site's /docs paths by route, slug and title match, reporting collisions and loops.

scripts/lib/faq-links.ts.name: FAQ link resolver
scripts/lib/faq-links.ts.description: Finds site-relative links in a rendered FAQ answer that resolve to no page, so a fetch fails before a broken link ships.

scripts/lib/faq-partial.ts.name: FAQ partial builder
scripts/lib/faq-partial.ts.description: Builds one troubleshooting partial from a FAQ snapshot and runs the write-or-check loop over all six; the core generate-faq wraps.

scripts/lib/faq-snapshot.ts.name: FAQ snapshot builder
scripts/lib/faq-snapshot.ts.description: Turns Notion FAQ rows into per-page snapshots, grouping by page key and ordering by the FAQ order index property.

scripts/lib/gas-target.ts.name: Gas-target renderer
scripts/lib/gas-target.ts.description: Validates the gas-target snapshot against the chain list and renders one section per chain with gas per second formatted in Mgas.

scripts/lib/generated-partial.ts.name: Generator shared helpers
scripts/lib/generated-partial.ts.description: Shared write-or-check core for every generator: the autogenerated marker, --check diffing, Prettier options, path guards and exit handling.

scripts/lib/go-source.ts.name: Go source indexer
scripts/lib/go-source.ts.description: Indexes a Go tree without a compiler: flag registration functions, imports, and the var ...Default literals their defaults point at.

scripts/lib/legacy-redirect-literals.ts.name: Legacy redirect literals
scripts/lib/legacy-redirect-literals.ts.description: Keeps the legacy SDK redirect exclusion and serializes external redirect entries as JavaScript string literals, never as code.

scripts/lib/line-diff.ts.name: Line diff
scripts/lib/line-diff.ts.description: Diffs two texts by line and renders the summary block the generators print to stderr in --check mode.

scripts/lib/nitro-cli-flags.ts.name: Nitro flag extractor
scripts/lib/nitro-cli-flags.ts.description: Walks Nitro's pflag registrations from the entry point, evaluates each default and formats it as nitro --help would print it.

scripts/lib/notion-mdx.ts.name: Notion block renderer
scripts/lib/notion-mdx.ts.description: Renders Notion API blocks and rich text to MDX, escaping everything MDX could interpret and rewriting docs.arbitrum.io links to site paths.

scripts/lib/partials.ts.name: Content file walker
scripts/lib/partials.ts.description: Walks content/ recursively, normalises paths to posix and tells an underscore-prefixed partial from a page.

scripts/lib/precompile-tables.ts.name: Precompile table renderer
scripts/lib/precompile-tables.ts.description: Parses the Solidity precompile interfaces and Go implementations, merges the hand-curated overrides and renders one partial per precompile.

scripts/lib/strip-code.ts.name: MDX code masker
scripts/lib/strip-code.ts.description: Locates fences, inline code, comments and frontmatter in MDX source so every text scanner can skip or mask them.

scripts/lib/stylus-examples.ts.name: Stylus page builder
scripts/lib/stylus-examples.ts.description: Builds one site page from an upstream page.mdx: parses its metadata literal, rewrites links and splices in the not-for-production banner.
